cause_of_bulge.units: raw cm for distances (output = raw x scale)

placement.muzzle_rule: thin barrel end with muzzle brake and front sight at raw -X, stock (tall butt plate) at raw +X; top already +Z (sight on top)

grip_point.rule: lowest vertex gives the grip; vertices with z <= -16.0 raw cm (under the trigger guard) within 14 raw cm of its x; hand hold = bbox centre of that set

placement.origin_check_in_output_frame: origin = grip hand hold; muzzle +X, top +Z
